versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-content-watcher.

- Extracts, transcribes, and analyzes video content from YouTube, Bilibili, and local files.
- Generates structured Markdown analysis reports via MiniMax LLM.
- Supports Chinese and English video analysis.
- Includes CLI and Python API for processing videos or raw text.
- Flexible configuration with environment variables for model and transcription settings.
